programme.title: Africa Express
programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship In the eighth episode, the contestants go to the legendary Fort Jesus in Mombasa, where a test of trust and courage awaits them.After a welcome ceremony led by locals, half of the participants disappear, and their partners must follow clues hidden in the fort's nooks and crannies to try to find them.Exploring dark cells, a dry cistern and bastions overlooking the ocean, players complete a demanding mission.The end of this trial surprises everyone.Instead of their own partners, the participants find other people and from then on they race in completely new duos.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: South Sudan is the youngest country in the world, established only two years ago.People's lives here are a constant struggle for survival.The heroine of the episode is Rebecca, who witnessed the bloody birth of the country.She took an active part in the fighting, marched with the rebels, carried water and to this day calls herself a soldier.Now Rebecca works as a midwife at Juba Teaching Hospital and delivers 40 or even 50 deliveries a day.She gave birth to eight children herself.This episode is a touching story of an extremely brave woman working with passion, but also a tragic picture of the fate of African women.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Every year, surrogate mothers in India give birth to approximately 25,000 babies.Nearly half of this number are 'orders' from Western couples.In Annand, Martyna meets Dr. Nyana Patel, who runs a fertility clinic and a surrogacy home.About eighty pregnant women are under her care.They are usually young and often illiterate girls from small towns, who thus earn the equivalent of ten years' income in just 9 months.The demand for their services is huge.The Polish traveler learns the stories of women who decided to rent their bodies to give birth to children to other people.He meets Manisia, who has three children of her own, and a married couple who, thanks to Dr. Patel and one of the surrogates, have the desired offspring.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Thailand, any teenager can legally buy and use hormones that will enable him to change his gender if he feels the need.Operations changing men into women and vice versa are also carried out on a massive scale in the country.Martyna meets a doctor who runs the oldest clinic in Bangkok offering this type of services, and assists him during the procedure.The traveler also meets his patients and looks behind the scenes of the selection of the most beautiful ladyboys in Thailand.He also meets a talented dancer, Lukpad, whom he accompanies in his everyday life and during preparations for the show in which she appears.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In southern China, at the foot of the Himalayas, Martyna Wojciechowska visits the Mosuo tribe.In their culture, there is no concept of father or husband, and the role of the head of the house is played by women who make all important decisions.They never marry, and their surnames are inherited by all family members.The traveler meets LaSuo, who lives with her daughter, mother, grandmother and uncle.The woman's father stays with her own mother, as do her daughters.Martyna will also learn the Mosuo dance, in which the first declarations are made between a man and a woman.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: This time, the host visits owners of ancient houses with their own history.The new hosts renovated these buildings and created their own places on the land where other families lived long ago.An international couple, Ania and Paul, are passionate about archives and monuments.They live in a two-century-old weaver's house, located in a charming land of extinct volcanoes.Kasia and Mariusz's love for the mountainous areas turned out to be stronger than their attachment to life in the capital.So they decided to permanently live in an 80-year-old farm at the very top of Paproć Hill.Kasia and Darek live in a dreamy old mill near Kazimierz Dolny.They preserved its historical character, adding only the necessary modernizations.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Konrad decided to use second-hand elements to build his house, such as old doors and windows.In turn, the architect Magda is interested in ecological construction.The heroine will present her favorite project, i.e. the metamorphosis of an old barn into a residential house.Karolina and Janusz have always dreamed of having their own plot of land with a nice view.Finally, they managed to fulfill this wish by purchasing land in Dobczyce, Lesser Poland.Due to the fact that they used almost the entire budget to buy the land, they had to find a way to build the estate for only PLN 6,000.zlotys.
